correctness.rationale: A complete shortest-distance MMD characterization gives H with outer cyclic edge distances {5,7,9,11,12}, inner {9,11} and no mixed edges. A five-clique partition of the 14 allowed outer indices proves alpha_outer <=6, attained explicitly. Five disjoint inner five-cycles prove alpha_inner <=10, attained by two residue classes modulo 5. Thus every strong resolving set contains >=50-16=34 vertices. The explicit complementary 34-set strongly resolves all 1225 pairs, checked directly by independent BFS and Floyd-Warshall distance routines. The finite graph is fully covered; no infinite-family statement is inferred.

value.rationale: An exact, rigorously established counterexample to an explicit conjectured infinite-family equality is mathematically substantive. The parameter n=25 arises as k=6, inside the published conjecture range; the difference 34 rather than 35 invalidates the general statement. Five outer clique groups and five inner pentagons explain the extremum rather than reporting only a solver number. The finite nature and absence of a repaired all-parameter classification are expressly disclosed.
